source_provenance.basis: Published almanac old-calendar entries; 1872 is pre-reform.
Provider reconstruction from published new moons and solar terms; 1923-1944 uses Nichiyo Benran for missing terms.
Provider follows Jingu almanacs. 1947 retains printed leap third month; 1969 corrects a large-almanac leap-seventh typo using the small almanac.
Reference projections from Rekijitsu Taikan; provider describes later Jingu comparison as planned, not completed.

monthly_endpoint_reconciliation.basis: All daily responses, adjacent month start and provider methodology's explicit 1989-01-08..02-05 example; earlier raw monthly bytes remain unchanged.

source_discrepancies_retained: Methodology page ends 2033-01-30, LOD entity ends 2031-01-22; the longer range is not accepted.
Calendar directory label 1002.2 links to entity 1002.1; no distinct API 1002.2 data are claimed.
Daily isLeap is a day-period flag; enclosing ofMonth.isLeap and printed 閏 identify leap months.
2015 onward is the provider's reference projection, not a verified whole Jingu edition.
scope: Frozen HuTime daily reference facts. UTC+09 is an explicit modern reference-date convention, not historical Japanese local time, a complete Tenpo/Tang reconstruction or a full Jingu facsimile collation.
